principle: Treat the handwritten sheet as a constrained engineering language, not as OCR text.

layers.meaning: what is visibly written, including mistakes and omissions
component sums, dimensional consistency, rounding residuals
repeated layout, dual seismic cases, recipe reuse, shared labels
human-reviewed fact eligible for model candidate; never automatic

decoder_rules.rule: Solve unreadable coefficients from total minus known invariant components, then compare against known author constants 550, 417, 800, ~540, 432, 840.
Pair two calculations when invariant components and tributary width match while seismic-variable coefficients change according to the author's sussultorie/ondulatorie convention.
Use page alignment as evidence only after arithmetic fingerprints agree.
A missing TRATTO reference can be inferred only if topology, recipe fingerprint, and author-layout convention converge; otherwise keep ND.
Never overwrite a literal source error. Store SOURCE_VALUE, EXPECTED_VALUE, DELTA, and interpretation separately.
Small arithmetic residuals <=1 kg/m are ROUNDING_OR_MANUAL_VARIANCE candidates; larger residuals require explicit anomaly review.
Repeated omissions at the same topological position across levels are evidence of a special structural condition, not automatically clerical omission.
